scope: ss 5, 7, 8 (who is a worker, who conducts a business or undertaking, what is a workplace); ss 19(1), (2), (4), 20, 21 (the primary duty of care, the duty to others, accommodation, the duty of the person with management or control of the workplace and of fixtures); s 17 with regs 35, 36 (eliminate, then the hierarchy of control); ss 4A, 27, 28, 29 (officers' due diligence, my own duties, others at the workplace); ss 30, 30A, 31-33 (serious harm; industrial manslaughter $5 000 000 / $10 000 000 and 20 years; Category 1 $680 000 / $340 000 / $3 500 000; Category 2 $350 000 / $170 000 / $1 800 000; Category 3 $120 000 / $55 000 / $570 000); ss 35-39 with reg 699 (notifiable incident, serious injury or illness including the WA 10-day medical opinion, dangerous incident, notifying the regulator, the 5-year record, the incident site); s 47 (consultation); ss 84-86, 88 (my right to stop unsafe work, the representative's direction, continuity of engagement); ss 104-106, 108, 110, 112, 113, 115 (discriminatory conduct for a prohibited reason; $115 000 / $570 000; the Tribunal within 1 year); ss 267, 272, 273 (no civil action under the Act outside Part 6; no contracting out; no levy on workers)
seat: the worker (the security officer injured in the tower)

roles: I work for a business or undertaking
I run a business or undertaking
I am a director or other officer of a business or undertaking

situation_parameters.name: I live in accommodation that a business I work for owns, manages or controls
situation_parameters.description: Whether you live in accommodation that the business you work for owns, or manages or controls (s 19(4) arises only then)
situation_parameters.role: I work for a business or undertaking
questions: Must my employer maintain the accommodation I live in

situation_parameters.name: an incident has happened at my work
situation_parameters.description: Whether something has happened at or arising out of your work that injured you or someone else, made someone ill, killed someone, or exposed someone to a serious risk to health or safety (the questions on serious harm and notifiable incidents, ss 30, 35-39, arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I work for a business or undertaking
questions: Is my injury serious harm under the Act
Is my injury or illness a serious injury or illness under the Act
Was what happened a dangerous incident
Is what happened a notifiable incident
Must this business notify the regulator of what happened
What is the most the business can be fined for not notifying the regulator
Until what date must the business keep its record of the incident
May the site of the incident be disturbed by this action

situation_parameters.name: I have ceased, or refused to carry out, work under section 84 or 85
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have stopped or refused work because of a serious risk from an immediate or imminent hazard (s 84), or on your health and safety representative's direction (s 85)
situation_parameters.role: I work for a business or undertaking
questions: Must I tell the business that I have stopped work
Is my continuity of engagement protected after I stopped work

situation_parameters.name: what was done to me
situation_parameters.description: What the business or person did to you, or threatened or organised against you (if none of these, the questions on discriminatory conduct do not arise)
situation_parameters.role: I work for a business or undertaking
questions: Was what was done to me discriminatory conduct
Is what was done to me an offence under section 104
What is the most the person who discriminated against me can be fined
Is my application to the Tribunal in time
Can the Tribunal make an order for me for what was done
Can the Tribunal order that I be reinstated or employed

situation_parameters.name: a worker of mine lives in accommodation I own, manage or control
situation_parameters.description: Whether a worker of yours lives in accommodation that your business owns, or manages or controls (s 19(4) arises only then)
situation_parameters.role: I run a business or undertaking
questions: Must I maintain the accommodation my worker lives in

situation_parameters.name: an incident has happened at work in my business or undertaking
situation_parameters.description: Whether something has happened at work in your business or undertaking that injured someone, made someone ill, killed someone, or exposed someone to a serious risk to health or safety (the questions on notifiable incidents, ss 35-39, arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I run a business or undertaking
questions: Is the injury or illness a serious injury or illness
Was it a dangerous incident in my business
Is what happened in my business a notifiable incident
Must I notify the regulator of the incident
What is the most I can be fined for not notifying the regulator
Within how many hours must I give the regulator a written notice once it requires one
Until what date must I keep my record of the incident
What is the most I can be fined for not keeping the record
May I disturb the site of the incident by this action
What is the most I can be fined for disturbing the site

situation_parameters.name: a worker of mine has ceased, or refused to carry out, work under section 84 or 85
situation_parameters.description: Whether a worker of yours has stopped or refused work because of a serious risk from an immediate or imminent hazard (s 84), or on a health and safety representative's direction (s 85)
situation_parameters.role: I run a business or undertaking
questions: Must the worker tell me that they have stopped work
Is the worker's continuity of engagement protected

situation_parameters.name: what I did, or would do, to the worker
situation_parameters.type: What I did to the worker
situation_parameters.description: What you did, or would do, to the worker or prospective worker, or threatened or organised (if none of these, the questions on discriminatory conduct do not arise)
situation_parameters.role: I run a business or undertaking
questions: Would this be discriminatory conduct for a prohibited reason
Would this be an offence for me under section 104
What is the most I can be fined for discriminatory conduct
